extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of Indian epic literature (Mahabharata); readers of prose retellings and mythology
extracted.subtask_description: An English prose retelling/translation of episodes from the Mahabharata, focusing on the story of Nala and Damayantí (swayamvara, divine suitors, possession by Kali, exile). The page is narrative fiction/mythic lore rather than instructional or evaluative content.
